criteria.name: Technical Knowledge
criteria.description: Demonstrates deep mastery of architectural concepts, frameworks, industry standards, and underlying runtime mechanisms.

criteria.name: Content Accuracy
criteria.description: Presents correct syntax, algorithms, design patterns, and bug-free logic with precision.

criteria.name: Practical Demonstration
criteria.description: Executes live coding effectively, articulates architectural trade-offs, and handles edge cases calmly.

criteria.name: Student Problem Solving Support
criteria.description: Patiently facilitates debugging strategies, scaffolds student thinking, and guides them towards root-cause discovery.

criteria.name: Technical Communication
criteria.description: Translates complex low-level concepts into digestible analogies and reinforces technical vocabulary.

criteria.name: Communication Skills
criteria.description: Clear articulation, appropriate vocal variety and pacing, structured delivery, and active listening.

criteria.name: Student Engagement
criteria.description: Employs active learning, Socratic questioning, breakout peer programming, and reaches disengaged learners.

criteria.name: Classroom Management
criteria.description: Maintains an inclusive, respectful environment, moderates discussion flow, and manages chat/questions smoothly.

criteria.name: Time Management
criteria.description: Starts and concludes punctually, paces lecture vs hands-on practice, and leaves time for Q&A.

criteria.name: Professionalism
criteria.description: Preparedness, high quality deck/repository materials, empathetic rapport, and constructive feedback tone.

feedbacks.generalComments: David continues to display master-level instructional quality in advanced frontend mechanics.
feedbacks.strengths: Outstanding live code architecture, clear conceptual analogies, and high student confidence.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Pace was slightly fast during the streaming SSR section for students newer to asynchronous streams.
feedbacks.recommendations: Add a 5-minute checkpoint recap after introducing complex streaming boundaries.

feedbacks.generalComments: Engaging, pedagogical masterclass in fostering collaboration among cohort students.
feedbacks.strengths: Student engagement and psychological safety in the virtual classroom are tier-one.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Time management during final lab wrap-up needs firmer timeboxing.
feedbacks.recommendations: Use an explicit visual timer during final student presentations to preserve buffer time.

feedbacks.generalComments: One of our strongest technical sessions this quarter. Students gained senior-level engineering heuristics.
feedbacks.strengths: Command of database internals, crisp explanations of high-throughput distributed systems.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Ensure terminal font size is bumped 2 points higher for students on lower-resolution screens.
feedbacks.recommendations: Share the reproduction queries script in repository immediately after class.

feedbacks.generalComments: Carlos delivered a well-crafted modern RAG workshop that demystified generative AI workflows.
feedbacks.strengths: Visualizing math and spatial intuitions; encouraging student curiosity.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Notebook pip installs took 10 minutes at the start; environment setup could be pre-baked.
feedbacks.recommendations: Provide a pre-configured Docker container or Google Colab link prior to class start.

feedbacks.generalComments: Solid technical session on mobile architecture with practical troubleshooting tips.
feedbacks.strengths: Real-world deployment perspective and honest debugging demeanor.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Live simulator glitches caused minor distraction in mid-session.
feedbacks.recommendations: Keep a warm backup emulator already compiled and running in the background.

feedbacks.generalComments: High impact security laboratory that gave students hands-on offensive and defensive skills.
feedbacks.strengths: Ethical rigor, live tooling mastery with Burp Suite and Wireshark.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Pacing was dense; a few beginners struggled to keep up with terminal shortcuts.
feedbacks.recommendations: Include a cheat-sheet of terminal flags in the pre-lab reading.

feedbacks.generalComments: Stellar design studio atmosphere that simulates a top-tier product team design critique.
feedbacks.strengths: Empathetic critique delivery, active student engagement, beautiful visual materials.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Ensure quieter students in remote breakouts get equal floor time.
feedbacks.recommendations: Implement a structured 3-minute round-robin timer per presenter during critiques.

feedbacks.generalComments: Excellent foundational TypeScript session that gave students genuine confidence in static typing.
feedbacks.strengths: Incremental complexity buildup, clean code habits.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: A few edge-case utility types could have used more visual breakdown.
feedbacks.recommendations: Provide a supplementary reference sheet on conditional types.

feedbacks.generalComments: Outstanding live lecture on advanced state architecture.
feedbacks.areasForImprovement: Slightly tight on time towards the end.
feedbacks.recommendations: Timebox questions to ensure lab buffer.
